source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the stages of drug discovery (PDF 208-209).

blocks.text: Drug discovery kisi bimari ki nayi dawa dhoondne ka pehla marhala hai. Jadeed dawaen chaar marhalon mein daryaft hoti hain.

items: Target ki pehchan: sciencedan bimari mein shamil koi khaas molecule, jaise protein ya enzyme, pehchante hain, is liye chuna jata hai ke dawa is par asar kar ke ilaaj kar sake.
Target ki tasdeeq: tajarbe tasdeeq karte hain ke target bimari mein ahem kirdar ada karta hai aur is par asar se shifa bakhsh nateeja mil sakta hai.
Lead compound ki pehchan: hazaron qudrati ya masnooi compounds jaanche jate hain ke kaun target se achhi tarah amal karte hain; umeed afza compounds lead compounds hain.
Lead ki behtari: lead compounds ko zyada mo'assar, kam zehreela aur dawa jaisi behtar khasiyaton wala banane ke liye badla jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Drug discovery ka pehla qadam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Target ki pehchan: bimari mein shamil woh molecule dhoondna jis par dawa asar kar sake.

items: Target ki pehchan, target ki tasdeeq, lead ki pehchan, lead ki behtari.
